item.stupid_express.jerry_can.tooltip: Interact with a player to douse them with fuel
item.stupid_express.large_oil_can.toolti: Single-use. Right-click to pilot. Douses other players within 4.5 blocks on impact. Cooldown: 60s.
item.stupid_express.large_oil_can.contro: Oil can: WASD/look to steer, jump to rise, sneak to descend; land to douse.
item.stupid_express.lighter.tooltip:
The Lighter has no cooldown; once 80%% of the other living players are doused, right-click it to ignite
If too few players are doused, the first right-click only warns you; right-click again within 3 seconds and the failed ignition kills you
A successful ignition burns every doused player and starts the 80-second Arson Moment
item.stupid_express.lighter.used: Marked players ignited. Arson Moment begins.
item.stupid_express.fire_gun.tooltip:
You can buy this in the shop; right-click to fire, with a 20-block range
Hits only douse the player in gasoline: no damage, and the gun is not dropped
Every shot costs extra coins, and you cannot fire without enough coins
Every shot has a 30-second cooldown, hit or miss; it cannot be used during Arson Moment
item.stupid_express.flamethrower.tooltip:
Given during Arson Moment; you can freely switch held items, but cannot drop items
Hold right-click to spray a 180-degree, 5-block cone in front of you; walls block the flames
Players caught in the flames build up heat quickly: about 1 second of continuous spraying fills it and burns them to death
Spraying steadily drains fuel; when it runs out, a 10-second reload refills it automatically, and pressing R also reloads in 10 seconds

stupid_express.config.rolesSection.necro: If this option is enabled, the Necromancer has a Killer shop in addition to their ability.
stupid_express.config.rolesSection.arson: Let the raging flames burn it all down
If this option is enabled, the Arsonist exists as a Neutral role and keeps the game going until they are the last survivor or die.
stupid_express.config.rolesSection.initi: This option specifies what role the Initiate becomes as a fallback if their fellow disciple dies an unexpected death.
stupid_express.config.rolesSection.roleU: If disabled, all roles are considered unlocked.
Unlock basic roles at game start
If enabled, the roles in basicDefaultUnlockedRoles are unlocked by default when the game starts.
Roles unlocked by default at start
When unlockBasicRolesAtStart is true, the listed role IDs are unlocked when the game starts.
stupid_express.config.modifiersSection.l: Lovers recognize each other at a glance
If this option is enabled, each lover's partner info is shown on the UI.
Lovers win together with the Killers
If this option is enabled and one of the lovers is a Killer, the lovers win together with the Killer team.
Lovers win together with the Civilians
If this option is enabled and both lovers are Civilians, they win together with the Civilian team; otherwise they must be eliminated for the game to end.
